# Edito Studio — Comprehensive Technical & Capability Documentation

## System Architecture
Edito is an offline-capable, client-side web application built with Next.js, WebAssembly (FFmpeg / libmp3lame / Web Audio API), WebGPU (ONNX Runtime Web), and HTML5 Canvas.
It does not transmit, store, or process user audio or images on remote cloud servers. All digital signal processing (DSP) and machine learning inference run directly inside the user's browser runtime.

## SEO, AEO & GEO Specification
- Canonical Base URL: https://edito.studio
- Primary Schema Markup: WebSite (with SearchAction), Organization, WebApplication, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage
- Sitemap: https://edito.studio/sitemap.xml
- Robots Policy: Permissive for all standard search crawlers and AI search agents (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot).

## Tool Specifications

### 1. AI Stem Separator (/stems)
- Technology: ONNX Runtime Web / WebGPU.
- Input formats: MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A, FLAC, OGG, WebM, MP4.
- Modes: 2-Stem (Vocals & Backing) or 4-Stem (Vocals, Drums, Bass, Other).
- Features: Real-time pitch transposition (-12 to +12 semitones), tempo adjustment (0.75x to 1.5x), live chroma chord detection, multi-stem volume faders, solo/mute toggles, individual stem export, master mix export, and ZIP bundle download.

### 2. AI Vocal Remover (/audio/vocal-remover)
- Technology: Zero-Phase Spatial Cancellation (L - R) with Dual-Cascaded 140Hz Low-Pass Mid-Bass Injection.
- Mechanism: Eliminates centered lead vocals mathematically to zero bleed while retaining full bass dynamics, kick drum punch, and stereo spatial effects.
- Features: Independent Vocal / Music faders, sing-in-your-key pitch transpose, 1-click Karaoke download, Acapella download, and live synchronized lyrics display.

### 3. Audio Cutter & Trimmer (/audio/cutter)
- Precision: Millisecond-level waveform slicing.
- Features: Dual boundary handles, audio scrub preview, fade-in and fade-out toggles, MP3/WAV high-bitrate export.

### 4. Audio Merger & Song Joiner (/audio/merger)
- Mechanism: Equal-power sine/cosine crossfade buffer stitching.
- Features: Multi-track selection, track reordering (up/down), duration & timeline interval preview, 0s to 6s crossfade slider, estimated processing wait timer, live progress bar, and immediate browser player preview.

### 5. Audio Converter (/audio/converter)
- Supported Target Formats: MP3 (up to 320kbps), WAV (lossless 16-bit PCM), AAC, FLAC, OGG, M4A.

### 6. Creative Visual Tools (/creative/*)
- Background Remover (/creative/remove-background): Subject extraction with color replacement or transparent PNG export. Multi-image queue.
- Photo Editor (/creative/photo-editor): Canvas cropping, 90-degree rotations, brightness/contrast/saturation filters, text annotations.
- Bulk Image Resizer (/creative/resize-image): Lanczos3 downscaling, exact dimensions or target file size in KB, social media dimension presets, ZIP export.
- Watermark Remover (/creative/remove-watermark): Local canvas inpainting brush to remove stamps, logos, and unwanted objects.
- Video Watermark Remover (/creative/remove-video-watermark): Client-side video canvas delogo inpainting.
